intro: This is only the beginning. Here are a few of the things I can't wait to do with you:

dreams.title: Umrah, together
dreams.text: Standing side by side before the Kaaba, praying for our little family.

dreams.title: Hajj, hand in hand
dreams.text: The journey of a lifetime — and I want to make it with you.

dreams.title: See all the countries
dreams.text: Every city, every sunset, every new adventure — with you beside me.

dreams.title: Buy our own home
dreams.text: A place full of love, laughter and Fiha's little footsteps.

dreams.title: Grow old laughing
dreams.text: Still holding hands, still telling the same jokes.

dreams.title: Every birthday, together
dreams.text: And make each one better than the last.
